title: 存在重复元素 III
summary: 判断是否存在下标距离不超过 indexDiff 且数值差不超过 valueDiff 的两个元素。
insight: 维护最近 indexDiff 个值的有序集合，对当前值查询第一个不小于 value-valueDiff 的候选。
pitfalls: 数值运算要用长整型避免溢出
查询后再把当前值加入窗口
窗口只保留允许的下标范围

solutions.title: 有序集合滑动窗口
solutions.idea: TreeSet 的 ceiling 可在线性扫描中查找允许数值区间内的候选。
steps: 移除下标 i-indexDiff-1 的旧值
候选<=value+valueDiff 时成功，否则加入当前值

code.java: class Solution { public boolean containsNearbyAlmostDuplicate(int[] nums,int indexDiff,int valueDiff){TreeSet<Long> window=new TreeSet<>();for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++){if(i>indexDiff)window.remove((long)nums[i-indexDiff-1]);long value=nums[i];Long candidate=window.ceiling(value-valueDiff);if(candidate!=null&&candidate<=value+valueDiff)return true;window.add(value);}return false;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun containsNearbyAlmostDuplicate(nums:IntArray,indexDiff:Int,valueDiff:Int):Boolean{val window=java.util.TreeSet<Long>();for(i in nums.indices){if(i>indexDiff)window.remove(nums[i-indexDiff-1].toLong());val value=nums[i].toLong();val candidate=window.ceiling(value-valueDiff.toLong());if(candidate!=null&&candidate<=value+valueDiff)return true;window.add(value)};return false} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: bool containsNearbyAlmostDuplicate(vector<int>& nums,int indexDiff,int valueDiff){set<long long> window;for(int i=0;i<(int)nums.size();++i){if(i>indexDiff)window.erase(nums[i-indexDiff-1]);long long value=nums[i];auto it=window.lower_bound(value-(long long)valueDiff);if(it!=window.end()&&*it<=value+(long long)valueDiff)return true;window.insert(value);}return false;} };
